warmup: Dr. Nair here, by the campfire! Press Pull it apart. Then drag the lens over each layer and find its clues. Is the chocolate still chocolate? And what happened to the marshmallow?
part1: Describe this wooden block without changing it. Drag a tool from the kit onto the block, and watch the ID card fill up. Some tools would change the wood. Which ones?
part3: Drag the time slider forward. Watch for clues to pop up. Tap each one, then stamp what kind of clue it is. And save Lady Liberty for last!
explore: Press Start the belt. Read each card as it rides along. Then tap the right bin before it reaches the end. Too fast? Tap the turtle to slow it down.
